upset.en: She felt upset when the event was cancelled without warning.
upset.zh: 活動毫無預警被取消時，她感到很沮喪。

upstairs.en: The language classroom is upstairs beside the computer lab.
upstairs.zh: 語言教室在樓上，位於電腦教室旁。

upward.en: The graph shows an upward trend in library attendance.
upward.zh: 圖表顯示圖書館使用人數呈上升趨勢。

upwards.en: The balloon moved upwards as the warm air lifted it.
upwards.zh: 熱空氣把氣球往上帶，使它向上移動。

urge.en: Teachers urge students to check reliable sources before sharing information.
urge.zh: 老師呼籲學生分享資訊前先查證可靠來源。

urgency.en: The announcement explained the urgency of repairing the damaged bridge.
urgency.zh: 公告說明修復受損橋梁的迫切性。

urgent.en: The school sent an urgent notice about tomorrow's schedule change.
urgent.zh: 學校發出一則關於明日時程變更的緊急通知。

us.en: The guide showed us the oldest part of the museum.
us.zh: 導覽員帶我們看博物館最古老的區域。

usage.en: The chart compares electricity usage across several school buildings.
usage.zh: 圖表比較幾棟校舍的用電量。

used.en: This room is used for meetings and small group activities.
used.zh: 這個房間用於會議和小組活動。

usher.en: An usher guided visitors to their seats before the performance.
usher.zh: 表演前，一名引導員帶訪客到座位。

utensil.en: Each cooking utensil was placed neatly beside the work area.
utensil.zh: 每件烹飪器具都整齊放在工作區旁。

utility.en: The report evaluates the utility of the new study tool.
utility.zh: 報告評估這項新學習工具的實用性。

utter.en: He did not utter a word during the quiet reading period.
utter.zh: 安靜閱讀時間裡，他一句話也沒說。

vacancy.en: The notice board lists a vacancy for a part-time library assistant.
vacancy.zh: 公告欄列出一個圖書館兼職助理職缺。

vacant.en: A vacant classroom was used for the afternoon workshop.
vacant.zh: 一間空教室被用來舉辦下午的工作坊。

vacuum.en: The physics lesson explained how sound behaves in a vacuum.
vacuum.zh: 物理課說明聲音在真空中的表現。

vague.en: The instructions were too vague, so the teacher clarified them.
vague.zh: 指示太模糊，因此老師進一步說明。

vain.en: Their first attempt was in vain, but they tried again.
vain.zh: 他們第一次嘗試沒有成功，但又試了一次。

valley.en: A river flows through the valley below the mountain village.
valley.zh: 一條河流經山村下方的山谷。

van.en: The school van arrived early to collect the equipment.
van.zh: 學校廂型車提早抵達來載運設備。

vanilla.en: The bakery used vanilla in the cake for a mild flavor.
vanilla.zh: 麵包店在蛋糕中加入香草增添柔和風味。

vanish.en: The morning fog began to vanish as the sun rose.
vanish.zh: 太陽升起後，晨霧開始消散。

vapor.en: Water vapor formed on the cool classroom window.
vapor.zh: 水蒸氣在冰涼的教室窗戶上凝結。

variation.en: The experiment measured variation in temperature throughout the day.
variation.zh: 實驗測量了一整天的溫度變化。

vase.en: A blue vase stood on the table near the entrance.
vase.zh: 入口附近的桌上放著一個藍色花瓶。

vast.en: The desert covers a vast area with very little rainfall.
vast.zh: 沙漠覆蓋廣大區域，而且降雨量很少。

vegetable.en: Each vegetable in the garden was labeled for the science project.
vegetable.zh: 花園裡的每種蔬菜都為科學專題貼上標籤。

vegetarian.en: The cafeteria offers a vegetarian meal option every day.
vegetarian.zh: 餐廳每天提供素食餐點選項。

veil.en: A thin veil of mist covered the lake at sunrise.
veil.zh: 日出時，一層薄霧覆蓋湖面。

velvet.en: The theater curtain is made from thick red velvet.
velvet.zh: 劇院布幕由厚實的紅色天鵝絨製成。

vendor.en: A local vendor supplied fruit for the school event.
vendor.zh: 一名當地供應商為學校活動提供水果。

venture.en: The students launched a small business venture for their economics project.
venture.zh: 學生為經濟課專題展開一項小型創業計畫。

venue.en: The organizers selected a larger venue for the final presentation.
venue.zh: 主辦單位為最後發表選擇了更大的場地。

verbal.en: The teacher gave verbal instructions before handing out the worksheet.
verbal.zh: 老師在發學習單前先口頭說明。

verdict.en: The mock trial ended when the student jury announced its verdict.
verdict.zh: 模擬法庭在學生陪審團宣布裁決後結束。

verse.en: The class analyzed one verse from the poem during discussion.
verse.zh: 班上在討論時分析了詩中的一節。

versus.en: The chart compares studying alone versus studying in a group.
versus.zh: 圖表比較獨自讀書與小組讀書。

vertical.en: Draw a vertical line through the center of the graph.
vertical.zh: 在圖表中央畫一條垂直線。

vessel.en: The research vessel collected water samples near the coast.
vessel.zh: 研究船在海岸附近採集水樣。

vest.en: The volunteer wore a bright vest during the outdoor event.
vest.zh: 志工在戶外活動期間穿著醒目的背心。

vet.en: The vet examined the rescued dog during the shelter visit.
vet.zh: 參訪收容所時，獸醫檢查了獲救的狗。

veteran.en: A veteran teacher shared classroom advice with new staff members.
veteran.zh: 一位資深教師和新進人員分享教學建議。

veterinarian.en: The veterinarian explained basic animal care to the class.
veterinarian.zh: 獸醫向全班說明基本的動物照護知識。

veto.en: The lesson explains how a president may veto proposed legislation.
veto.zh: 課堂說明總統如何否決已提出的法案。

via.en: The files were shared via the school's online learning platform.
via.zh: 這些檔案透過學校的線上學習平台分享。

vibrate.en: The phone began to vibrate quietly during the meeting.
vibrate.zh: 會議期間，手機開始輕輕震動。

vibration.en: The sensor detected a slight vibration in the machine.
vibration.zh: 感應器偵測到機器的輕微震動。

victor.en: The tournament's victor received a trophy at the closing ceremony.
victor.zh: 錦標賽的勝者在閉幕典禮上獲頒獎盃。

viewer.en: Each viewer can choose subtitles from the settings menu.
viewer.zh: 每位觀眾都能從設定選單選擇字幕。
